channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Alcolumbre promulga PL da Dosimetria, que reduz pena de Bolsonaro
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre promulgated the Dosimetry Law after Congress overturned President Lula’s veto, potentially reducing sentences for those convicted of the January 8 acts, including Jair Bolsonaro. Approved in December 2025 as an alternative to amnesty, the law requires Supreme Court validation to take effect. The promulgation without presidential sanction underscores escalating tensions between the Executive and Legislative branches, following two government defeats in 24 hours.

item.title: Encontro entre Lula e Trump: o impacto no bolsonarismo e a avaliação nos bastidores
item.description: The meeting between Lula and Trump in Washington was seen as a political victory for the Brazilian president, marked by the temporary suspension of U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods for 30 days and discussions on access to critical minerals and rare earths. Despite domestic wear and tear, including the defeat of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, Lula extended the meeting from 30 minutes to nearly three hours and received public praise from Trump, weakening the narrative of the Brazilian right. Analysts said the gesture had symbolic impact and strengthened Lula's image amid commercial and political tensions.

item.title: Dá para confiar nos EUA? Economista analisa encontro Lula e Trump
item.description: The meeting between Lula and Trump was politically positive for avoiding tensions, yet it has not yet produced concrete economic effects. Economist Patrícia Krause notes the meeting served to open a dialogue channel and reduce political noise, but the market awaits objective measures, particularly on tariffs. Although the 30-day negotiation period is seen as a positive signal, it is considered insufficient to resolve long-standing trade disputes.

item.title: Governo renova concessões de energia em 13 Estados, com investimentos de R$ 130 bi
item.description: The Lula government announced the early renewal of electricity distribution concessions for 14 companies across 13 states, projecting R$130 billion in investments through 2030. The move aims to prevent investment stagnation by imposing stricter contractual rules on service quality, transparency, oversight, and technological modernization. Enel was excluded due to an ongoing Aneel process over recurring supply failures, while Light’s renewal was confirmed with a R$10 billion commitment to upgrade Rio de Janeiro’s grid.

item.title: É #FAKE vídeo de Flávio Bolsonaro dizendo que vai criar 'auxílio sacolão de osso'; áudio foi manipulado com IA
item.description: A video circulating on social media shows Flávio Bolsonaro claiming he will create a 'bone basket allowance', but the content is an AI-manipulated edit of a genuine video from November 2024. Detection tools confirmed high probability of voice cloning, with up to 98% likelihood the audio was artificially generated. The original video contains no mention of such aid and was taken out of context to spread misinformation.

item.title: Ciro Nogueira diz ser alvo de perseguição política após ação da PF
item.description: Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI) accused the Federal Police of political persecution after being targeted in Operation Compliance Zero, which investiges alleged frauds linked to Banco Master. He linked the investigation to the 2026 electoral year, recalling a similar episode in 2018 when he was cleared by the STF following Lava Jato allegations. Nogueira claimed the attacks strengthen his campaign and his commitment to Piauí voters.

item.title: Na Casa Branca, Lula convidou Donald Trump a visitar o Brasil
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva invited U.S. President Donald Trump to visit Brazil during a meeting at the White House. The invitation was made in a relaxed setting, with Lula noting he had previously made the same request in phone calls. Aides said Trump thanked Lula for the invitation but did not give a concrete response on whether he would accept or when he might visit.

item.title: Em SC, Flávio lança pré-candidatura ao Planalto no sábado
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro will launch his presidential pre-candidacy in Florianópolis (SC) on Saturday, alongside his brother Carlos Bolsonaro (pre-candidate for Senate) and other PL candidates in the state. A Futura/Apex poll shows Flávio would defeat Lula in Santa Catarina in a potential runoff, while a national Real Time Big Data survey indicates a technical tie between the two, with Flávio holding a slight edge in the second round (44% to 43%).

item.title: Crusoé: Caso Master precisa ser apurado “doa a quem doer”, diz Tarcísio
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas stated that the Banco Master scandal must be investigated thoroughly, 'come what may', one day after the Federal Police launched the fifth phase of Operation Compliance Zero, targeting Senator Ciro Nogueira. The operation investigates alleged illicit financial flows and connections between the bank and political figures.

item.title: Gilmar sobre impeachment: “Não me assusto com esse tipo de ameaça”
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes said he is not intimidated by threats of impeachment against justices, in response to a campaign by PL pre-candidates supporting such measures. He defended the STF’s independence and stated these attempts do not frighten him. The remarks were made in an interview with BandNews radio on Friday, the 8th.

item.title: Master: Tarcísio reage à operação da PF que mirou aliado Ciro Nogueira
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas defended the Federal Police investigation into the Banco Master scandal involving Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP), stating that the probe must proceed regardless of who is involved. He downplayed the postponement of a PP-organized event in support of his re-election, emphasizing the strength of his political alliance, which includes Republicans, PL, PSD, MDP, PP, União, and Podemos.

item.title: Após dois feriados, Motta dá semana de trabalho remoto para deputados
item.description: After two weeks disrupted by national holidays, Chamber President Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB) authorized deputies to work remotely next week, with attendance and voting conducted via the Infoleg system. The move allows lawmakers to focus on pre-campaign activities while maintaining legislative duties. Remote voting was restricted in November following the case of former deputy Alexandre Ramagem, who continued voting from the U.S. despite a Supreme Court conviction.

item.title: Lula pede a Trump para encerrar investigação comercial que envolve o Pix, e governos de Brasil e EUA vão negociar tarifas
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva requested that President Donald Trump halt the U.S. commercial investigation into Brazil's Pix payment system. The request was made during their meeting at the White House on Thursday. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Após operação contra Ciro Nogueira, Tarcísio diz que caso Master precisa ser investigado 'doa a quem doer'
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas stated that the Federal Police operation against Senator Ciro Nogueira, linked to the Banco Master scandal, will not impact his re-election campaign, but emphasized the case must be investigated 'no matter who it hurts,' underscoring the seriousness of corruption allegations and public demand for justice. He insisted all involved parties must be scrutinized, regardless of political ties.

item.title: O prazo para candidato de Zema colocar o ‘bloco na rua’ em Minas
item.description: Matheus Simões' (PSD) campaign for Minas Gerais governor expects polling improvements only by late June, when advertising materials will be released. Until then, the pre-candidate struggles with low public recognition. The campaign message centers on the succession of Romeu Zema (NOVO), emphasizing that his administration brought funds for Minas to 'breathe' after Fernando Pimentel's government.

item.title: Dosimetria: Alcolumbre promulga lei que beneficia condenados pelo 8/1
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre promulgated the Dosimetry Law, which reduces sentences for those convicted of the January 8, 2023 attacks, including attempted coup and assault on the Three Powers. The law was enacted after Congress overrode President Lula’s veto, which he argued harmed public interest by benefiting those responsible for crimes against democracy. The STF has sentenced 1,400 individuals, with penalties ranging from fines to 27 years in prison for Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Alcolumbre promulga a Lei da Dosimetria após Lula deixar o prazo expirar
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre promulgated the Dosimetry Law after President Lula let the 48-hour deadline to sanction or veto the bill expire. The law, passed by Congress with a large majority, reduces sentences and eases parole rules, directly benefiting former President Jair Bolsonaro and others involved in the January 8, 2023 attacks, by allowing sentence reductions of up to two-thirds and blocking cumulative sentencing for related offenses.

item.title: Davi Alcolumbre promulga Lei da Dosimetria
item.description: Senate and Congress President Davi Alcolumbre promulgated the Dosimetry Law (PL 2.162/2023), which reduces penalties for the January 8, 2021 anti-democratic acts. The bill had been vetoed by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, but the veto was overturned by Congress on April 30. The promulgation occurred because the President of the Republic did not sign the law within the constitutional 48-hour period.

item.title: El Supremo de Virginia tumba un mapa electoral aprobado en las urnas que favorecía a los demócratas
item.description: Virginia's Supreme Court struck down a state constitutional amendment approved by referendum in April that favored Democrats in electoral redistricting. The ruling, seen as a blow to Democratic prospects in the November midterm elections, declared the amendment 'null and void'. This reignites the national debate over gerrymandering in the United States.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula anuncia medidas para o setor de energia
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Minister Alexandre Silveira announced new investments in energy distribution and the modernization of the 'Luz para Todos' program, aiming to universalize electricity access in Brazil. The 'Sente a Energia' event took place in Brasília on Friday, May 8, 2026, underscoring the government's commitment to energy inclusion and sustainable development.

item.title: Davi Alcolumbre promulga PL da Dosimetria após inércia de Lula
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre promulgated the Dosimetry Bill after President Lula failed to act within the 48-hour window for sanction, despite the congressional override of his veto. The law unifies penalties for coup-related crimes and eases prison progression rules, potentially benefiting those convicted in the January 8 attacks, including former President Bolsonaro. Judges like Alexandre de Moraes had previously denied sentence reduction requests due to the law’s non-application, but such petitions are expected to be refiled now.

item.title: Alcolumbre promulga lei que reduz penas dos condenados pelo 8 de Janeiro
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre promulgated a law reducing sentences for those convicted in the January 8, 2023 attacks, directly benefiting former President Jair Bolsonaro, whose sentence was cut from 27 to 20 years. The law prohibits cumulative sentencing for coup attempt and abolition of the democratic state, and reduces penalties by up to two-thirds for participants in crowd contexts who did not finance or lead the acts. The promulgation followed Congress overriding Lula’s veto, with Alcolumbre citing executive inaction within the constitutional 48-hour period.

item.title: Alcolumbre promulga Lei da Dosimetria, que beneficia Bolsonaro, após fim do prazo para ato de Lula
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre promulgated the Dosimetry Law after the presidential sanction deadline expired, benefiting Jair Bolsonaro and allies involved in the January 8 acts by reducing sentences and facilitating regime progression for crimes against the Democratic State. The law was enacted by overturning Lula's veto, with Alcolumbre engineering a maneuver to prevent the veto from being fully maintained, which could have benefited heinous criminals. The measure has sparked congressional tension and may be challenged in the Supreme Court by the governing coalition.

item.title: Crusoé: Guru, pré-candidato e líder capissocial
item.description: The article discusses how Brazilian celebrities often attempt to enter politics, citing Silvio Santos as an example, who tried to run for office under the obscure Brazilian Municipalist Party shortly after the end of the military dictatorship. Despite their fame and broad reach, such attempts typically have short duration and limited electoral impact.

item.title: Alcolumbre promulga lei que reduz pena de Bolsonaro após Lula deixar prazo expirar
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) promulgated the sentencing law on Friday after President Lula let the 48-hour constitutional deadline for action expire. The law reduces penalties and eases regime progression rules, benefiting those convicted of the January 8, 2023 attacks, including former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest. The promulgation followed Congress's override of Lula's veto by wide margins — 318 to 144 in the Chamber and 49 to 24 in the Senate.

item.title: Davi Alcolumbre promulga PL da Dosimetria e abre caminho para redução da pena de Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Davi Alcolumbre promulgated the Dosimetry Law, which reduces sentences for those convicted of the January 8 attacks, including former President Jair Bolsonaro, after Congress overrode President Lula's veto. The veto was initially issued on January 8 but was overturned by the Chamber of Deputies (318-144) and the Senate (49-24), meeting the required thresholds. Lula chose not to promulgate the law to avoid having his 'fingerprint' on it, leaving the duty to Alcolumbre, while the government announced it will challenge the measure in the Supreme Court.

item.title: Após Ciro Nogueira, o possível próximo alvo das investigações sobre o Banco Master
item.description: Investigations into the Banco Master scandal are intensifying in Brasília, with Senator Ciro Nogueira again being pointed to as a target due to his longstanding ties with businessmen and politicians, reinforced by Lava Jato plea bargains. Columnist Robson Bonin stated the case will shape the 2026 electoral campaign and indicated that Senate President Davi Alcolumbre is the next possible major target of the Federal Police, causing concern both within Bolsonarist circles and the Lula government.

item.title: Lula fala de 'amor à primeira vista' com Trump e descarta interferência dele nas eleições
item.description: President Lula met with Donald Trump in Washington to discuss key issues including organized crime, critical minerals, tariffs, and trade, describing their rapport as 'love at first sight' while ruling out any interference by Trump in Brazil's 2026 elections. The meeting takes place amid domestic challenges for both leaders in their respective countries.

item.title: Aldo Rebelo diz que Zema é desqualificado e critica ideia de vender o BB
item.description: Aldo Rebelo (DC) criticized Romeu Zema (Novo) as 'uninformed' and 'unqualified' for advocating the privatization of Brazilian state-owned enterprises like Banco do Brasil and Petrobras, warning that such sales could transfer strategic national assets to foreign entities, particularly Chinese state-owned enterprises due to their superior financial capacity. Rebelo argued Brazil cannot afford this 'stupidity' and defended maintaining state control over strategic companies.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro age para ligar escândalo do Master ao PT e pressiona por CPI
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) used social media to directly link the Banco Master scandal to the PT, pressuring for a CPI to investigate the financial institution and its alleged ties to the party’s national and Bahian leadership, without mentioning Ciro Nogueira, a Bolsonaro ally and PF investigation target. He noted that the PT refused to sign the CPI request while the opposition supported it, implying fear of what might be uncovered.

item.title: Lançamento de plataforma gratuita de streaming do MinC só depende da agenda de Lula
item.description: The free streaming platform from Brazil's Ministry of Culture, named Tela Brasil, has faced repeated delays since its planned November 2024 launch. Its implementation depends solely on President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's agenda, according to sources. The project aims to democratize access to Brazilian cultural content but remains without a confirmed release date.

item.title: Penduricalhos: STF manda registrar em contracheque único e veta manobras
item.description: The STF ruled that all public servant payments, including allowances and benefits, must be recorded in a single payslip and published on Transparency Portals. The decision aims to prevent administrative maneuvers that indirectly increase salaries, such as reclassifications of positions or jurisdictions, and ordered the CNJ and CNMP to standardize indemnity payments nationwide.

item.title: Lula está “caladinho” sobre operação contra Ciro Nogueira, diz Zema
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's pre-candidate for president, criticized Lula's silence regarding the Federal Police operation targeting Senator Ciro Nogueira, claiming without evidence that PT members are involved and that investigations will advance through analysis of phones, laptops, and plea bargains. He likened the case to a 'metastasis' and said it will influence the October presidential election.

item.title: Governo renova concessões de distribuição de energia em 13 estados; Enel fica de fora
item.description: The Ministry of Mines and Energy signed early renewals for 14 electricity distribution concessions across 13 states, excluding Enel, which faces a potential concession revocation in São Paulo due to service failures. The new contracts are expected to unlock R$130 billion in investments by 2030 for grid modernization, expansion, and improved consumer service, including stricter financial accountability and pole-sharing regulations. Specific projects include new substations and lines in Bahia, Paraíba, and Sergipe, with President Lula expected to attend the signing ceremony.

item.title: Marketing de Caiado traça estratégia para ampliar eleitorado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD-GO) will launch his media campaign in June with TV advertisements aimed at introducing him to the national electorate, emphasizing his achievements in Goiás in economic development, security, and education. The strategy seeks to expand his visibility in the South, North, and Northeast regions, where he is less known, highlighting that his final government approval rating exceeded his 2022 vote share, supporting the message 'the candidate even those who didn’t vote for approve of'.

item.title: Tarcísio defende investigação sobre caso Master: ‘Doa a quem doer’
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas urged for a thorough investigation into the Master Bank case, stating it must be pursued 'no matter who it hurts', despite Senator Ciro Nogueira — a PP ally and Tarcísio-backed Senate pre-candidate — being targeted in the Federal Police operation. He downplayed the postponement of the PP event, emphasizing that his political alliance extends beyond the party to include Republicans, PL, PSD, MDB, Union, and Podemos.

item.title: Lula reforça discurso de combate ao crime organizado após encontro com Trump
item.description: President Lula reinforced his discourse on combating organized crime following a meeting with Donald Trump at the White House, emphasizing international cooperation and the imminent launch of the 'Brazil Against Organized Crime' plan. The plan, targeting the financial structure of criminal factions, will be unveiled next week and integrates intelligence and security force coordination. The initiative comes amid poor public approval of the government's security performance, according to a Ideia poll.

item.title: A investigação que coloca a JBS de Joesley Batista na mira do governo Trump
item.description: The Trump administration is investigating JBS Foods USA and National Food (Brazilian-controlled) for alleged anticompetitive practices in the U.S. meat industry, alongside Cargill and Tyson Foods. The probe coincides with Lula and Trump’s meeting in Washington, though the issue was not formally on the bilateral agenda.

item.title: PT foi contra abertura da CPI do Master, diz Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) accused the Workers' Party (PT) of opposing the initiation of a Parliamentary Inquiry Commission (CPI) into the Banco Master case, claiming PT deputies did not sign the request for investigation. He linked the case to alleged benefits for Lula allies, including payments to Jaques Wagner, Guido Mantega, and Lewandowski, and an unofficial meeting between Lula and the bank's owner. Despite these claims, the text notes that the PT later intensified pressure for the CPI's installation amid internal criticism, with leaders like Paulo Pimenta and Pedro Uczai supporting the inquiry.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que suspeitas no caso Master devem ser investigadas, após Ciro Nogueira entrar na mira
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas stated that suspicions in the Banco Master case must be investigated 'no matter who is involved', following a PF search warrant against Senator Ciro Nogueira of the PP, a political ally. He emphasized the investigation should not harm his re-election campaign and noted that PP events were postponed, but affirmed his coalition remains strong with other parties.

item.title: Embraer registra receita recorde no 1º trimestre, apesar das tarifas de Trump
item.description: Embraer reported record revenue of 7.6 billion reais in Q1 2026, driven by strong defense performance, but net profit fell to 145.4 million reais due to lingering U.S. tariffs on machinery, which remain in place despite broader tariff reductions on Brazilian exports. The company announced final assembly of the E175 jet in India and a deal to sell 10–20 C-390 aircraft to the UAE, while President Lula met with Trump to seek tariff relief.

item.title: Como a imprensa americana noticiou o encontro entre Lula e Trump
item.description: American press highlighted the Lula-Trump meeting as a moment of 'easing tensions' after over a year of diplomatic strain, including tariffs and sanctions. The Wall Street Journal praised the effort for a 'reset' in bilateral relations, citing personal rapport and Trump’s transactional approach as key factors, while the New York Times described it as a 'fragile truce'. The meeting was seen as strategic for Lula, who aims to improve U.S.-Brazil ties without appearing subservient, particularly amid 2026 elections and Bolsonaro clan influence.

item.title: ‘Excelente química’, ‘dinâmico’ e ‘inteligente’: o que Trump já disse sobre Lula
item.description: Trump has repeatedly praised Lula, citing 'excellent chemistry' and describing him as 'dynamic', 'intelligent', and 'a good guy'. Their White House meeting lasted nearly three hours and covered trade and tariffs, with both leaders expressing satisfaction with the bilateral relationship. Despite prior tensions, including sanctions on Brazilian Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, Trump reversed some measures and signaled interest in deepening ties.

item.title: O recado de Gilberto Kassab sobre a candidatura presidencial de Ronaldo Caiado
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, states that Ronaldo Caiado's presidential candidacy is certain, even without coalition allies or TV time, citing Bolsonaro's 2018 election as precedent. He confirms the ticket will include a PSD vice-presidential candidate and that the party will release a series of videos in June to promote Caiado's record in Goiás on economy, security, and education, aiming to reach voters weary of the current political polarization.

item.title: Com rejeição de Messias, duas mulheres ganham força para vaga no STF
item.description: Following the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias for the STF vacancy, speculation grows over Lula appointing a woman to fill Luís Roberto Barroso's seat. The leading candidates are Daniela Teixeira (STJ minister) and Edilene Lobo (former TSE minister), both previously nominated by Lula and praised for competence, integrity, and representativeness. The administration aims to announce the choice by May, emphasizing judicial excellence and court legitimacy.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Quaest mostra disputa Lula x Flávio após caso Messias e encontro com Trump
item.description: The new Quaest poll, set for release on April 13, will measure the Lula vs. Flávio Bolsonaro race following recent polls showing the senator’s gains. With 2,004 face-to-face interviews and a 2-point margin of error, it aims to determine whether Bolsonarist momentum has solidified or if the race has stabilized.

item.title: Messi aponta seleções 'à frente' da Argentina para a Copa de 2026 e cita Brasil entre favoritas
item.description: Lionel Messi stated that Argentina is not the main favorite for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, citing France, Brazil, Spain, and Portugal as teams in better form or with strong title chances. He praised France’s continued strength as the 2022 runner-up and acknowledged Brazil’s historical pedigree despite recent instability. Regarding Portugal, he noted it is arriving at one of the most competitive moments in its recent history.

item.title: Governo quer aprovar aumento da mistura do biodiesel no diesel até o fim do ano; testes começam neste mês
item.description: The government aims to approve by the end of 2024 an increase in the mandatory biodiesel blend in diesel from 15% to 16% (B16), with technical tests starting this month, funded by R$30 million from the FNDCT and private contributions. Technical viability is required for the CNPE to deliberate, in line with the Future Fuel Law, which mandates an annual 1-point increase until reaching 20% by 2030. The proposal was reinforced by President Lula’s public endorsement of biodiesel as an accessible renewable fuel.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula enrola com o Desenrola
item.description: Lula relaunched Desenrola 2.0, a debt renegotiation program aimed at helping 27 million Brazilians. The government acknowledges that the original Desenrola, launched in 2023, failed to meet its goals, making this updated version an attempt to correct prior shortcomings. The initiative comes amid electoral pressure and seeks to improve public perception of the government’s financial inclusion efforts.

item.title: Janaína Paschoal quer Tereza Cristina no lugar de Ciro no PP
item.description: São Paulo city councilwoman Janaína Paschoal (PP-SP) urged that Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) temporarily assume the presidency of the Progressistas party while investigations against Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI) in Operation Compliance Zero are ongoing, stating that his removal would not imply guilt but protect public integrity. She emphasized that the PP has capable internal leadership to avoid strengthening the União Brasil party, with which it is federated. The Federal Police launched a new phase of the operation, investigating fraud tied to Banco Master, executing search and seizure warrants and one arrest warrant against Nogueira, including allegations of monthly payments and free use of a luxury property.
